### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

## Creating

## packaging solutions

## for life's essentials.

Greif is a global leader in packaging products and services and is pursuing its vision: be the best
performing customer service company in the world. We produce steel, plastic and fibre drums,
intermediate bulk containers, reconditioned containers, flexible products, containerboard, uncoated
recycled paperboard, coated recycled paperboard, tubes and cores and a diverse mix of specialty
products. 

We also manufacture packaging accessories and provide filling, packaging and other services for a
wide range of industries, along with managing timber properties in the southeastern United States.
Greif is strategically positioned in more than 40 countries to serve customers of all sizes and
needs.

Greif 2030 Sustainability Targets

## 2030 SUSTAINABILITY TARGETS

These targets set specific and measurable goals that build on the company’s announcement in 2021 to
reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions 28% by the end of the decade.

The broader sustainability focus for the company continues to be advancing a circular economy,
reducing greenhouse gas emissions, and championing diversity, equity & inclusion initiatives.

[Learn More][126]
Target One: Waste

## 97%

**Reach Zero Waste to Landfill at 97% of its Production Facilities**

By reducing, recycling, composting, reusing, and incinerating with energy recovery, Greif targets
97% of its production facilities achieving zero-waste to landfills by 2030.

[Learn More][127]
Target Two: Circularity

## 100%

**Make 100% of its Products Recyclable** 

Working across a vast portfolio of raw materials and products, Greif recyclability targets will be
benchmarked by weight, and consolidated at a company level.

[Learn More][128]
Target Three: CIRCULARITY

## 60%

**Achieve an Average of 60% Recycled Raw Material Content Across Products**

Recycled content targets for Greif products are minimum averages benchmarked across a portfolio of
materials and products by weight, consolidated at a company level.

[Learn More][129]
Target Four: DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

## =

**Attain Global Gender Pay Parity**

Greif is on track to ensure colleagues receive equal pay for equal work by 2024 and is committed to
maintaining gender pay parity.

[Learn More][130]
Target Five: Suppliers

## 80%

**Evaluate the Sustainability Performance for 80% of Total Spend with Suppliers**

By aiming to increase the evaluation of the sustainability performance of its suppliers, Greif can
have a greater impact across its value chain.

[Learn More][131]

## GREIF LAUNCHES 2023 SUSTAINABILITY REPORT

Greif’s 2023 Sustainability Report covers our fiscal year from November 1, 2022, through October 31,
2023. This report is prepared in accordance with the GRI Standards and SASB Application Guidance and
fulfills the United Nations Global Compact’s (UNGC) annual Communication on Progress (COP).

## Creating

## packaging solutions

## for life's essentials.

Greif is a global leader in packaging products and services and is pursuing its vision: be the best
performing customer service company in the world. We produce steel, plastic and fibre drums,
intermediate bulk containers, reconditioned containers, flexible products, containerboard, uncoated
recycled paperboard, coated recycled paperboard, tubes and cores and a diverse mix of specialty
products. 

We also manufacture packaging accessories and provide filling, packaging and other services for a
wide range of industries, along with managing timber properties in the southeastern United States.
Greif is strategically positioned in more than 40 countries to serve customers of all sizes and
needs.

Greif 2030 Sustainability Targets

## 2030 SUSTAINABILITY TARGETS

These targets set specific and measurable goals that build on the company’s announcement in 2021 to
reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions 28% by the end of the decade.

The broader sustainability focus for the company continues to be advancing a circular economy,
reducing greenhouse gas emissions, and championing diversity, equity & inclusion initiatives.

[Learn More][126]
Target One: Waste

## 97%

**Reach Zero Waste to Landfill at 97% of its Production Facilities**

By reducing, recycling, composting, reusing, and incinerating with energy recovery, Greif targets
97% of its production facilities achieving zero-waste to landfills by 2030.

[Learn More][127]
Target Two: Circularity

## 100%

**Make 100% of its Products Recyclable** 

Working across a vast portfolio of raw materials and products, Greif recyclability targets will be
benchmarked by weight, and consolidated at a company level.

[Learn More][128]
Target Three: CIRCULARITY

## 60%

**Achieve an Average of 60% Recycled Raw Material Content Across Products**

Recycled content targets for Greif products are minimum averages benchmarked across a portfolio of
materials and products by weight, consolidated at a company level.

[Learn More][129]
Target Four: DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

## =

**Attain Global Gender Pay Parity**

Greif is on track to ensure colleagues receive equal pay for equal work by 2024 and is committed to
maintaining gender pay parity.

[Learn More][130]
Target Five: Suppliers

## 80%

**Evaluate the Sustainability Performance for 80% of Total Spend with Suppliers**

By aiming to increase the evaluation of the sustainability performance of its suppliers, Greif can
have a greater impact across its value chain.

[Learn More][131]

## GREIF LAUNCHES 2023 SUSTAINABILITY REPORT

Greif’s 2023 Sustainability Report covers our fiscal year from November 1, 2022, through October 31,
2023. This report is prepared in accordance with the GRI Standards and SASB Application Guidance and
fulfills the United Nations Global Compact’s (UNGC) annual Communication on Progress (COP).

## Sustainability in Action

[recycling]

### Recycling

Greif paper packaging is a net-positive recycler. Creating materials from scratch has a significant
impact on the environment. Contact us about our recycling services, including collecting paper,
paperboard, and plastics, to developing custom solutions.

[ Learn More ][139]
[green tool calculator icon]

### Green Tool

Calculate your carbon footprint with Greif. Both easy and cost-effective, the Greif Green Tool
provides insight into the environmental impact of packaging used for fillers and emptiers. It makes
local reporting seamless and empowers smart sustainability choices.

## **Greif Barrier Technology**

We design and manufacture containers that do more than hold products, they actively protect what
matters most. Greif’s expertise in barrier science and technology helps keep your product exactly
where it belongs: inside the package, not absorbed into the container walls or released into the
surrounding environment.
* Reduces Emissions And Leakage Risks
* Maintains Product Purity During Storage And Transport
* Protects Against Oxygen, Moisture And Chemical Exposure
* Customizable Barrier Solutions For Your Specific Needs

[ Learn More ][143]
[ [Steel Drum 360 3000x4500 1] ][144]

## THINK OUTSIDE THE DRUM WITH DRUM360

Your drums don’t have to blend in, make them bold. Drum360 gives you the freedom to showcase
vibrant, full-color designs that amplify your brand wherever it goes. From events to retail displays
to everyday packaging needs, these drums are more than containers, they’re your next big marketing
moment.
* Full-spectrum printing for maximum visual impact
* Tailored designs that reflect your brand identity
* Endless creative possibilities for packaging and beyond

recycled packaging material. PCA is also committed to:
* Energy efficiency
* Renewable energy resources
* Responsible design, manufacturing and delivery

## End-to-End Pharmaceutical Packaging Solutions by Accupack Engineering

Since its inception in 2001, **Accupack Engineering** has earned a reputation for delivering
innovative packaging solutions, engineering excellence, and technological expertise to the
pharmaceutical industry.

With deep expertise in pharmaceutical packaging automation, we design and manufacture **blister
packing machines, cartoning machines, tertiary packaging systems, format parts, and complete
packaging lines** tailored to meet the evolving needs of pharmaceutical manufacturers worldwide.

From standalone machines to fully integrated packaging lines, our solutions are engineered for
maximum productivity, precision, reliability, and regulatory compliance. Backed by decades of
experience and a customer-centric approach, we help pharmaceutical companies optimize their
packaging operations with confidence.

Trusted by leading pharmaceutical manufacturers across the globe, Accupack delivers customized,
end-to-end packaging solutions that ensure seamless integration, consistent performance, and
long-term value.

**Have a unique packaging challenge or a special application with no standard solution? Talk to us.
When others can’t… Accupack can.**

# WHY CHOOSE US

Get a glimpse of our journey and what we do best.

[][22]

## OUR OFFERINGS

Our unified, end-to-end solutions help pharma companies across the world with the agility to adapt
to the ever-changing market dynamics. Ensuring faster, productive, efficient production with
uncompromised quality.

#### **Blister Machine**

Comprehensive blister packaging solutions, from a thermoforming machine, cold forming machines and
lab models.

#### **Format Parts**

Highest level of quality with the precise fitting that meets your requirements perfectly for
seamless plug and play integration.

#### **Blister Line**

All-in-one integrated systems combining Blister Machine and Cartoning ideal for all pharmaceutical
companies that focus on maximum efficiency.

#### **Cartoning
#### Machine**

State-of-the-art machines that facilitate long runs with minimal operator intervention to deliver
fast and efficient cartoning.

#### **Format Parts Carrier-
#### EasyCare**

A convenient and compactly designed format parts carrier, Easycare ensures safety with the
systematic and quick changeover.

#### **Operational Intelligence
#### Software- PLEXUS**

Plexus is a smart format parts management software that helps reduce inventory cost and boost
management efficiency.

## SINCE 2001

Thoughtfully designed in Europe and Smartly engineered in India

## End-to-End Pharmaceutical Packaging Solutions by Accupack Engineering

Since its inception in 2001, **Accupack Engineering** has earned a reputation for delivering
innovative packaging solutions, engineering excellence, and technological expertise to the
pharmaceutical industry.

With deep expertise in pharmaceutical packaging automation, we design and manufacture **blister
packing machines, cartoning machines, tertiary packaging systems, format parts, and complete
packaging lines** tailored to meet the evolving needs of pharmaceutical manufacturers worldwide.

From standalone machines to fully integrated packaging lines, our solutions are engineered for
maximum productivity, precision, reliability, and regulatory compliance. Backed by decades of
experience and a customer-centric approach, we help pharmaceutical companies optimize their
packaging operations with confidence.

Trusted by leading pharmaceutical manufacturers across the globe, Accupack delivers customized,
end-to-end packaging solutions that ensure seamless integration, consistent performance, and
long-term value.

**Have a unique packaging challenge or a special application with no standard solution? Talk to us.
When others can’t… Accupack can.**

# WHY CHOOSE US

Get a glimpse of our journey and what we do best.

[][22]

## OUR OFFERINGS

Our unified, end-to-end solutions help pharma companies across the world with the agility to adapt
to the ever-changing market dynamics. Ensuring faster, productive, efficient production with
uncompromised quality.

#### **Blister Machine**

Comprehensive blister packaging solutions, from a thermoforming machine, cold forming machines and
lab models.

#### **Format Parts**

Highest level of quality with the precise fitting that meets your requirements perfectly for
seamless plug and play integration.

#### **Blister Line**

All-in-one integrated systems combining Blister Machine and Cartoning ideal for all pharmaceutical
companies that focus on maximum efficiency.

#### **Cartoning
#### Machine**

State-of-the-art machines that facilitate long runs with minimal operator intervention to deliver
fast and efficient cartoning.

#### **Format Parts Carrier-
#### EasyCare**

A convenient and compactly designed format parts carrier, Easycare ensures safety with the
systematic and quick changeover.

#### **Operational Intelligence
#### Software- PLEXUS**

Plexus is a smart format parts management software that helps reduce inventory cost and boost
management efficiency.

## WHY PARTNER WITH US

With over 2 decades of experience in manufacturing and supplying, here are some reasons to work with

# High-Quality Packaging Solutions and Customized Services

C.L. Smith (CLS) is a premier, full-service bottle manufacturer, UN Certifier, and full-stocking
distributor of high-quality and cost-effective packaging materials and containers.

[CONTACT US][243]
1975

4

Satisfied Customers

## Who We Are

At C.L. Smith, our mission is simple: make your packaging challenges easier and your business
stronger. For 50 years, we’ve built our reputation on exceptional customer care, partnering with
companies like yours to deliver packaging solutions that protect your products, simplify your supply
chain, and help you grow.

As a full-service packaging partner, we offer custom design, manufacturing—including bottle
molding—and single-source purchasing for hazmat containers and everyday packaging needs. Now part of
the Novvia Group, we combine local expertise with a nationwide network, ensuring fast, dependable
service wherever you do business.

Experience how C.L. Smith’s passion for service and commitment to your success can make a difference
for your business.

[Learn More About Us][244]
[Three professionals in a warehouse: a man in a safety vest and helmet holds a plastic jug, while a
woman with a laptop and a man with a clipboard smile and discuss the product among shelves of
containers.]

## What We Do

[[containers]][245]
[[bottle molding]][246]
[[custom designed]][247]
[[hazardous mat]][248]

## Is your company in need of trusted hazardous material packaging?

Our HAZPlus division offers turn-key service to ensure compliance: design, testing, certification
and manufacturing.

[LEARN MORE][249]

## C.L. Smith Company Customer Promise

[number 1 in a circle]

Years of experience working with hundreds of companies like yours has taught us a very valuable
lesson: **We Exist for Our Customers!** Our business is molded to fit yours—not the other way
around. So we make your challenge ours—we fight for the right solution, no matter what it takes. And
what drives us as a company is the desire to do everything in our power to **MAKE YOUR LIFE
EASIER!**

[number 2 in a circle]

**C.L. Smith** is a company where you can find

**Blow Molding, UN Packaging, Container and Packaging Distribution, and [Custom Designed
Packaging][250]** all under one roof. So, whether you’re looking for packaging, product packaging,
packaging design, manufacturing, or shipping, we are your Partner in Packaging Solutions.

[number 3 in a circle]

We understand that you have a choice – you have a say – and we’re listening! You, our Customer, come
first—your goals are ours, and partnerships are measured in years, not profits.

**WE ARE C.L. SMITH, and we are proudly “ALL IN FOR YOU!”**

[[A brochure cover featuring an arrangement of various plastic bottles and containers above abstract
red and black geometric shapes. The text "C.L. Smith, a Novvia Group Company" is prominently
displayed in the center.]][251]

Want to learn a bit more about us? Download our brochure!

[Download Now][252]

for our business.

As a hazardous materials distributor, we need reliable and compliant packaging, C.L. Smith’s [custom

We recently switched to C.L. Smith’s industrial round bottles for our chemical products, and the

## THE CRATERS & FREIGHTERS NETWORK

### A National Shipping Powerhouse with Local Support.

At Craters & Freighters®, we have a nationwide network of offices and a multitude of global
resources to provide our customers with specialty crating, packaging and a seamless transportation
process. Behind this powerhouse however, are your local representatives who take full responsibility
for ensuring the safety of your valuable items and who are there when you have questions or
concerns.

### Check Out Our New Video!
### Expertise that delivers.

Our decades of experience in crating, packaging, and shipping mean your items are in good hands. We
utilize firsthand knowledge and professional tools to ensure everything about the packaging and
shipping of your assets is streamlined from start to finish.

[About Craters & Freighters][103]

## FAST & EASY PROCESS

### We can pack, crate and ship your most heavy, difficult or valuable items.

Finding a specialty packaging, crating, and shipping company to handle the custom jobs can be a big
task, however we’re eager to get in there and find the perfect solution. Our teams welcome any
challenge and do whatever it takes to achieve a successful outcome. We are committed to
[sustainability][104], and focused on reducing the environmental footprint of our packaging and
production activities.

[hand with mobile phone]

#### STEP 1

Contact us to discuss
your needs.

[delivery truck]

#### STEP 2

We provide a quote with a
recommended approach.

[warehouse workers]

#### STEP 3

Once approved we package,
crate and/or ship your item.

### Why Craters & Freighters?

When it comes to packaging, crating, and shipping, certain words carry a great deal of weight –
words like experience, know-how, and integrity. Our long list of happy clients will tell you they
rely on us because we’re unrivaled in these areas.

## COMPREHENSIVE OFFERINGS

### [Commercial Services][105]

From [engineering][106], [logistics][107], and [auction services][108], to [hazmat expertise][109]
and [office relocations][110], we provide the full spectrum of services for businesses.

## TRANSPORTATION EXPERTS

### [Shipping Services][111]

Whatever you need to move, we can get it there, with white-glove service if required:
[electronics][112], [military][113], [medical][114], [manufacturing][115], [aerospace][116],
[hazmat][117] and [white-glove][118].

## CAREFUL MOVES

### [Residential Services][119]

[Estate moves][120], [senior moves][121], and the moving of [arts][122] and [antiques][123],
[furniture][124], and [motorcycles][125] are just some of the services we provide to residential
customers.

## PROTECTION PERFECTED

### [Crating][126] & [Packaging Services][127]

What do you need? [ISPM 15 certified wood crates][128]? [On-site crating][129], [custom
crating][130], or [custom packaging][131]? [Custom pallets and skids][132]? We can do that!

## CONTINUOUSLY INVESTING IN EARTH-FRIENDLY OPERATIONS

### Sustainability: Taking Action to Protect the Environment

We are global stewards at the forefront of incorporating advanced technologies and eco-conscious
manufacturing techniques. Our approach is holistic, emphasizing the development of reusable
packaging solutions that are not only innovative but are also made from materials that are
responsibly sourced and fully recyclable. This commitment extends throughout our operations,
ensuring that every aspect of our process contributes to a more sustainable future.

[Earth-Friendly Solutions][133]

  * Aerospace parts, motorcycles, furniture, fragile items

  * Shock absorbers, drop sensors, tip n' tell sensors

HAZMAT SHIPPING IS
COMPLICATED AND RISKY.

[its] [worth] [doing] [right]

Partner with the experts who have been doing hazardous material packaging for over 30 years and who
utilize the world's most rigorous 3rd party testing on all Hazmatpac shipping products.

[UN Certified Packaging]

# The Experts Get It Right,** Every time**

Where other packaging manufacturers sell hazmat containers alongside a multitude of other packaging
options, Hazmatpac ONLY does hazmat shipping. And we’ve done it for over 30 years.

[im sq ceo hazmatpac]
[img sq female scientist hazmatpac]
[img sq customer service hazmatpac]
[img sq delivery hazmatpac]

A lot of trust goes into hazmat shipping. You trust your supplier to deliver the right container for
your product. You trust the labels are correct. You trust the packaging contains your product
without spills or leaks that create a safety hazard for your employees. You trust that your
containers and labels keep you compliant with all regulations.

**So why not trust the experts who have done the most to earn that trust? **

[img sq customer service 2 hazmatpac]

## Trust the Experts to help you manage your hazmat shipping - ** Safely**

### Shipping and storing hazardous materials is dangerous. It’s also highly regulated. Don’t take
### the chance of getting it wrong.

Our customer service reps are highly trained and knowledgeable in all relevant U.S. and
international codes and regulations. They are here to guide you through the process of selecting the
right type of certified container for your specific needs – keeping you compliant and your people
safe.

Our products undergo the most rigorous 3rd party testing in the world, ensuring maximum safety, and
therefore trust, for you and your team. When you’re ready to take the leap to working with the
experts in hazmat shipping and storage, give us a call.
